Wonguk's condition suddenly deteriorates, forcing Minwoo and Jaein to rush into emergency treatment. As the media proposes producing a documentary about Wonguk's story, the hospital chairman orders Minjun to save the patient—regardless of who performs the surgery.

The chairman asks Inhyuk what is needed to establish a trauma center, leaving Inhyuk torn over whether to bring the highly skilled Euna onto the team. Meanwhile, Inhyuk, Jaein, and Minwoo face a harrowing dilemma: deciding who to operate on first—a kidnapper who knows the child's whereabouts, or an injured detective.

Confronted once again with moments of solitude and choice at the patient's bedside, Minwoo and Jaein are forced to reflect on what it truly means to face a life alone. Meanwhile, a patient with a shattered pelvis is rushed in, and Seongjin—who has fellowship experience in pelvic surgery—comes down from Orthopedics, only to hesitate over whether to proceed with the operation.

During a dinner together, Inhyuk offers his congratulations to Euna and her fiancé, but an unmistakable tension lingers between the two men. Meanwhile, the ER is flooded with patients stung by jellyfish after a seaside outing—only to be thrown into further chaos when three men and women arrive with shotgun wounds.

Perry Park rushes to the scene despite warnings when he hears that a woman has been kidnapped by bikers. Ri Jin closely observes Do Hyun's completely changed demeanor. Do Hyun later attends the Seung Jin Group board meeting and is officially appointed vice president, but Tae Im slaps him in anger for being late.
A new personality appears in Do Hyun — this time, that of a young child — leaving him shocked. Meanwhile, Se Gi drags Ri Jin off to somewhere unknown.

Se Gi, who has kidnapped Ri Jin, asks her to make Do Hyun disappear forever. Director Ahn begins tracking their whereabouts. Meanwhile, Do Hyun ends up at Ri On's house, and Ri On introduces him to his family as “Mr. Perry.”

Do Hyun can't stop thinking about Ri Jin, which only fuels Se Gi's jealousy. Eventually, Se Gi warns him, “If you touch my woman, yours will be in danger.” Provoked, Do Hyun goes to Ri Jin and asks her to become his secret personal doctor.

Tae Im questions Director Ahn about the reason for Do Hyun's return to Korea, leaving him flustered. Ri Jin struggles to stop Yo Seob from taking his own life. Hwa Ran orders someone to find Min Seo Yeon's long-lost child, while Do Hyun begins strategizing to meet the mysterious writer Omega.

Gi Joon proposes to Chae Yeon, but she gets angry at his attitude. Ri Jin agrees to be Do Hyun's secret doctor, but is shocked to learn she has to live in the same house as him. Thus begins their uneasy and awkward cohabitation.

Ri Jin encounters all of Do Hyun's personalities in one night — except for Shin Se Gi. Gi Joon and Chae Yeon are stunned when Ri Jin shows up at the company as Do Hyun's secretary, while Ri On meets Do Hyun under his secret identity as Writer Omega.
Jini hands the hair tie to Kim. When Kim tries to receive it, Eunho jumps inside, saying that he shouldn't. Right then, Baekmu is there with a sword.

One late night, Jini is drunk and is walking with a liquor bottle in her hand. She is in her undergarments and her hair is undone. The day was the fourth year after Eunho died. Jini walks into the dark river.

Jini invites the risk of death by throwing the poem that Ming envoy Jangmyeong wrote into the furnace. But she restores herself with her intelligence. Byeokgyesu cannot help but take interest in Jini.
Kim Jeonghan cannot sleep when he thinks of Jini in the bedroom of Byeokgyesu. Buyong prepares a table in her home and invites Kim Jeonghan, but he refuses.
Kim Jeonghan is knocked unconscious, trying to protect Jini from the falling beam. Learning that it was intentional, Baekmu corners the courtesans.
Jini is left alone on the stage due to Buyong's conspiracy. Jini overcomes it with her wit, but the dance fails.

The gang war in Philadelphia is mostly centered around two rivals: Dame, the ruthless leader of the Umbrella organization, whose money and firepower have put him at the top of the crime world; and Beans, the one-time crime overlord hell-bent on taking back the city. The wild card is El Pollo Loco, a new player on the scene. His strategy involves teaming up with one side against the other -- but in reality, Loco has no plans to share Philadelphia with anyone.

After an overzealous district attorney's drug bust lands her in jail, single mother Dee Roberts (Nicole Beharie) must face an agonizing choice: Plead guilty and go home a convicted felon, or fight the charges and risk a lengthy prison sentence. Despite her mother's (Alfre Woodard) advice and risking everything, innocent Dee chooses to fight the Texas criminal justice system, joined by an ACLU attorney (Tim Blake Nelson) and a former narcotics cop (Will Patton).

Writer-director Paul Haggis interweaves several connected stories about race, class, family and gender in Los Angeles in the aftermath of 9/11. Characters include a district attorney (Brendan Fraser) and his casually prejudiced wife (Sandra Bullock), dating police detectives Graham (Don Cheadle) and Ria (Jennifer Esposito), a victimized Middle Eastern store owner and a wealthy African-American couple (Terrence Dashon Howard, Thandie Newton) humiliated by a racist traffic cop (Matt Dillon).

Successful Los Angeles football coach John Bookman returns home to Gary, IN, when his father is murdered. Discovering the town overrun with violent street gangs, John is even more horrified to learn his father was shot by a member of the Rebels, a gang John himself helped form in his youth. John teams up with Jake and Laurie, the parents of a boy who was also killed by a Rebel, to organize their neighborhood against gang violence.

programmes.st: Lost in a Space That Isn't There
programmes.d: The Abyss has infected Beka. The crew must find a way to save her.
After some of the crew is captured, Harper is forced to work on a time bridge for the Patriarch.
A spy from Tri Gemma shows up on the Andromeda in an attempt to steal the Star Map.
When Rommie becomes too emotional, the ship cuts her access in order to run diagnostics. This leaves the ship vulnerable to a Magog attack.
The Abyss kills Beka's friend, and the crew must figure out what information they killed for.
Andromeda rescues a ship returning from peace talks with the Magog. An attack is coming.
The Magog attack has dire consequences. The Andromeda is destroyed, Trance and Dylan are presumed the only survivors, and Dylan escapes into the Route of Ages.
Dylan ends up on Seefra, where the superstitious population has no technology. Rhade is there, none too happy to see Dylan.
Beka is dumped on Seefra after the Andromeda is stolen, and Dylan must prove the ship is his.
Still, on Seefra, Dylan finds Harper, who has adjusted to life there, and the mysterious Doyle.
It turns out Doyle is an android, built by Harper to contain Rommie's core programming. During a battle with androids from the future, a way out of Seefra is destroyed.
Beka wins a prize from a radio DJ, learns the truth about Seefra, and locates the Meethus Diagram - but has no idea what it does.
A scientist from the original Commonwealth shows up, caught in a time loop.
Flavin returns, sparking a gang war, and helps Dylan develop as a Paradine.
A crystal that can restore the Andromeda's power is discovered, but in order to get it, Dylan must work for the mine's owner - who uses slave labor.
Tunnels are discovered on Seefra which can be used to reach eight other Seefra planets.
When an old man is killed, Beka, Rhade, and Harper are the main suspects and stand trial.
Jotaro and his fellows take camels and travel across the desert, headed for Cairo. Along the way, though, they can't shake the sensation that someone or something is watching their every move.

Kakyoin dreams about being in a strange amusement park, where he encounters the Death tarot card. While in the dream he witnesses Death cut down a dog, but after waking up in terror he can't remember what the nightmare was about.
Kakyoin tries to convince the others that the baby is a Stand user, but they merely start to doubt his sanity. Unable to persuade his friends, Kakyoin resorts to some extreme measures.
Jotaro and the team visit an island in the Red Sea and find Avdol's father, renewing the grief Polnareff felt over his friend's death. But perhaps there is a way he can right that wrong. Or not.
Polnareff revives his sister Shelly using one of his three wishes but is then attacked by her. The enemy Stand user, Cameo, then says he'll grant Polnareff's last wish and revives Avdol.

programmes.t: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: The High Priestess, Part 1
programmes.d: Jotaro and the others obtain a submarine as a new means of transport, but as they travel through the Red Sea they realize that there are few places to escape to should danger arise underwater.

programmes.t: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: The High Priestess, Part 2
programmes.d: The team attempts to escape the submarine with scuba gear as it sinks under attacks from the shape-changing enemy Stand "High Priestess."

programmes.t: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Iggy the Fool and Geb's N'doul, Part 1
programmes.st: Iggy the Fool and Geb's N'doul, Part 1
programmes.d: Jotaro and his friends finally land in Egypt, where DIO awaits, and are cutting through the desert when a helicopter approaches. The helicopter belongs to the Speedwagon Foundation and is there to make a special delivery requested by Joseph.

programmes.t: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Iggy the Fool and Geb's N'doul, Part 2
programmes.st: Iggy the Fool and Geb's N'doul, Part 2
programmes.d: Jotaro and crew acquire the help of Iggy but are ambushed by a water Stand. With Kakyoin injured, Avdol tries out a stratagem which the unseen enemy quickly sees through. Meanwhile, Iggy is napping.

programmes.t: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Khnum's Zenyatta and Thoth's Mondatta
programmes.d: After the battle with N'doul, Kakyoin and Avdol are badly hurt, so the group heads for a hospital in Aswan. Unfortunately, dangerous enemies could be all around them even there.

A young man named Chaka finds a mysterious sword on the beach. Though other men try, Chaka is the only one who can draw it. The sword claims Chaka as its master and sends the youth in pursuit of Jotaro and his friends with deadly intent.

Having defeated the "Anubis" Stand user Chaka, Polnareff pays a visit to a barber. But when the barber starts attacking him with Chaka's sword, the Frenchman realizes the sword itself is the Stand user.

programmes.t: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Bast's Mariah, Part 1
programmes.d: On the way to Luxor, Joseph notices an electrical outlet set in a rock. Fascinated by the rare sight, Joseph goes in for a closer look and gets shocked. Though he seems fine afterward, soon all manner of small accidents begin to occur around him.

programmes.t: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Bast's Mariah, Part 2
programmes.d: Due to the powers of an enemy Stand, Joseph's body becomes magnetized. While chasing after the woman he suspects is the Stand user, Joseph learns that Avdol has also become magnetized from touching a different electrical outlet.
Though he's been doing the hero gig for three years, Saitama realizes that the public knows nothing about him.
It's been five days since Saitama became a professional hero, and he has yet to do anything heroic.
An enormous meteor hurtles toward City Z. Genos decides it's up to him to protect the home of his master and stop the meteor, no matter what the cost.
A pack of monsters calling themselves the "Clan of the Seafolk" arrives on the shores of City J, intent on invading the land.
Maria’s masked servant is none other than Zero’s twin brother, Ichiru, whom Zero has not seen since their separation long ago…
Yuki learns that Maria’s true identity is Shizuka, the pureblood vampire who bit Zero and turned him into a vampire.
After suffering a mortal wound, Shizuka dies in Ichiru’s arms. Meanwhile, Yuki and Zero try to find where Shizuka may have gone, but Zero is constantly thwarted by his Level E seizures…
After Shizuka Hio’s death, peace is restored at the academy. As usual, Yuki is busy with her duties as Guardian when Zero, who has been gone for quite some time, comes back.
Misa succeeds in narrowing down the Kira suspects in the Yotsuba Group to one: Higuchi.
Higuchi of the Yotsuba Group attempts to kill Matsuda of the task force, and is surprised when he doesn't die after 40 seconds.
Higuchi is captured and tells the investigators about the Death Note.
Light, his memory recovered, orders Misa to begin killing after Higuchi dies.
Light has removed everyone in his way and is closer to achieving his perfect world.
A new investigator steps forward, Near, a central figure in the SPK, an organization that is trying to catch Kira without relying on L.

programmes.st: Mark Stacey and Thomas Plant, Day 1
programmes.d: Thomas Plant and Mark Stacey begin their adventure in Kent. Along the way, Thomas visits the life-saving underground world of Ramsgate, and Mark finds out about the science behind a lighthouse in Dover.

programmes.st: Mark Stacey and Thomas Plant, Day 2
programmes.d: Mark Stacey and Thomas Plant continue their trip through the Kent countryside. Mark is trailing behind, but can he catch Thomas when they head to an auction in Paddock Wood?

programmes.st: Mark Stacey and Thomas Plant, Day 3
programmes.d: Antiques experts Thomas Plant and Mark Stacey are halfway through their road trip, and they shop in Essex and Suffolk before making their way to an auction in Cambridge.

programmes.st: Mark Stacey and Thomas Plant, Day 4
programmes.d: Thomas Plant and Mark Stacey hunt for antiques across East Anglia. Along the way, Thomas hears the inspiring story of a pioneering nurse and Mark learns the incredible history of a Dunwich lost to the waves.

programmes.st: Mark Stacey and Thomas Plant, Day 5
programmes.d: It's the last leg for antiques experts Mark Stacey and Thomas Plant as they travel through Norfolk. With less than £30 separating them, the pressure's on as they head to their final auction in Oakham, Rutland.

programmes.st: Natasha Raskin Sharp & Margie Cooper, Day 1
programmes.d: A brand new Road Trip pairing in a 1960's classic car. Auctioneer Natasha Raskin Sharp and dealer Margie Cooper do the west of Scotland. Expect treasure hunting and curry eating.

programmes.st: Natasha Raskin Sharp & Margie Cooper, Day 2
programmes.d: Margie Cooper and Natasha Raskin Sharp hit the antique shops of Scotland to uncover an unusual pyjama case and a rare piece of Victoriana. Both hoping for big profits at auction.

programmes.st: Natasha Raskin Sharp & Margie Cooper, Day 3
programmes.d: Margie Cooper and Natasha Raskin Sharp are antiquing in the Lake District. The battle is on for victory in the third auction, but who will come out on top?

programmes.st: Natasha Raskin Sharp & Margie Cooper, Day 4

Back home for Christmas, Elly May bonds with her old animal friends, while Pearl plays the piano for the "new" movie in town (the silent version of Ben Hur) to impress Mr. Brewster.
Granny is determined to go back home even if she has to walk back all by herself. When she reaches Las Vegas she has second thoughts. Jethro gets arrested by an undercover cop.
Jed and Mr. Drysdale try matching Ellie with the bank's new CPA Fred Penrod (or Rod Fredpen) while Lafe continues to try to find where "Jed has his money buried".

Granny is worried about Miss Jane's spinsterhood and convinces Jethro to ask her to marry him. Granny assures him that she will decline the proposal, but Hathaway accepts, leading to panic in the Clampett household.
Jed, Granny, Elly May, and Jethro man the front lines against an expected invasion of grunion, which they believe to be hostile aliens.
Granny wants to go home because folks are so unfriendly no one has come to call.
Daddy Farquhar continues to visit the Clampetts' mansion to his daughter Margaret's displeasure. He has plans for Granny and her money in Las Vegas but she's expecting a marriage proposal.

Jethro is evicted because his 50 cent allowance won't cover the rent. The other Clampetts take over the space with Granny will cut hair or pull teeth. Jed will sharpen tools and whittle something. Ellie is the pretty receptionist.

Mr. Drysdale wants Jed to incorporate for the tax advantages. So the Clampetts take over the top floor of the Commerce Bank and start doing what they can to stimulate the economy by getting more money into the hands of more people.
The Clampetts pack up to return to Beverly Hills, so Jethrine tries to pack Jazzbo Depew. Elly says goodbye to her animals
Mr. Drysdale's biggest rival John Cushing succeeds in getting the Clampetts to transfer all of their money to his bank.
Mr. Drysdale talks the Clampetts into hiring a housekeeper. Unfortunately, the housekeeper that is hired is uninterested in doing housework.
When a couple who ran into the Clampett's car discover that they're rich, they fake injuries and sue the Clampetts.

While Granny boils pool water for washing due to the "lack of a pump" and Elly May gets a feminine make-over by Miss Hathaway, cousin Pearl is back at the cabin making eyes with the visiting oil man while he gives her a ride to the nearest phone.

Granny and Jethro believe they have psychic abilities, but Granny's predictions stop coming true. With her reputation on the line, she picks a stock for Mr. Drysdale that could cost him a small fortune.

Mr. Brewster, the oil man who made Jed a multi-millionaire, arrives in Beverly Hills with his wife planning to build their dream house. Jed and Granny think they have the perfect house in mind for their dream home.
Elly May gets a job at Mr. Drysdale's bank and moves into co-worker Jane Hathaway's apartment.
Dylan, injured in a surfing incident, stays with the Walshes during his recovery - until Jim Walsh kicks him out for kissing Brenda!
After an illegal late-night poker game, Brandon and Dylan clash over a break-in at the beach club.
Kelly is mortified when her mother starts dating David's father and plots to break up the new couple.
The gang heads up to Yosemite on what turns out to be a totally doomed camping trip.
An effort to create a neighborhood security patrol goes horribly awry resulting in race hate and violence.

When Dylan's long-absent mother moves back into his life - not to mention into his home - things come to a head, forcing Dylan to confront his issues not only with his mother, but with himself as well.
Brandon and Brenda's paraplegic cousin Bobby is visiting Beverly Hills - and Kelly finds him extremely interesting!
Andrea wins a high-school journalism contest, but her victory is marred by a school district investigation.
The gang goes to a Halloween party, but things take a turn for the worst when Kelly's seductive costume catches the eye of a college student whose intentions are less than honorable.
Emily invites everyone to a secret party at an underground club - where she does something that could end her relationship with Brandon forever.
Emily refuses to accept the fact that Brandon no longer wants to see her and spirals out of control - and Brenda's the only one who might be able to talk her down.
Brandon makes a connection with an aspiring figure skater that could melt ice - but is banned from seeing her by her overprotective coach.

Hattie ponders the idea of creating a strategic business deal with Vivian after sales are slow at the diner. Meanwhile Sam, Drew & Danny argue over who will receive a promotion at work.

Ashley reveals the real reason she left Don. Jess flies back to London. Fly drops off Prince at the courthouse to turn himself in. Charmaine finds out the gender of her baby. The Chicago Tribune article drops and Van pops up to talk to Charmaine.

Danny and Baez investigate a local bombing but meet with tension and resistance from the community during the investigation.
Danny’s loyalty is tested when he is assigned to the case of a childhood friend, Mickey, who is under investigation for having ties to an infamous mob family.

When Danny learns from Nicky that there’s a deadly new brand of heroin hitting the streets, he begins an all-out manhunt for the distributor. Meanwhile, Frank pulls out all the stops to assist in getting the drugs off the street.

Danny and Baez must track down a Marine veteran who Danny thinks is suffering from PTSD. Meanwhile, Frank is caught off-guard during a press conference by a woman who is seeking justice for her murdered daughter.
Danny and Baez investigate the murder of Tiffany Lamp, a popular drag queen from a reality television show who was found murdered in a local park.
When Danny and Baez investigate the kidnapping of a young girl who disappeared after school, it brings back difficult memories for Danny, who worked on a similar unsolved case many years ago.
When Danny takes a call from a woman who is threatening to kill herself along with the man who killed her parents in a drunk driving accident, he rushes to find her.

Danny and Baez investigate when an expectant mother is a victim of a 'knockout game,' in which teenagers punch unsuspecting civilians in the head. Meanwhile, Frank wrestles with promoting an officer when he thinks it can be viewed as favoritism.

Danny and Baez investigate the death of a woman whose body was dumped after she was killed by a lethal dose of lidocaine following secret plastic surgery. Meanwhile, Frank privately assigns Jamie a cold case and Erin tries out speed dating.
Danny and Baez investigate the murder of a respected college professor who was involved with a questionable scholarship program.

When Erin is assigned to investigate a case in which an on-duty police officer is accused of killing a suspect already in custody, Frank urges her to stick to the facts to avoid a publicity scandal for the NYPD.
When a detective from Danny’s precinct is killed while working undercover, Frank puts on a full-court press to find his killer, only to discover that the deceased had a big secret.
When Danny is placed on modified duty after investigating a case that was off-limits, he realizes he stumbled upon something that someone is trying to keep quiet.
As Danny and Baez escort confiscated drugs to a remote location for incineration, their convoy is attacked and Baez is seriously injured, leaving Danny to track down the drug cartel responsible.
Danny and Baez are temporarily assigned new partners when an officer is outed and his current partner won't ride with him.

Boomer Esiason will appear as himself when he pays a visit to Commissioner Frank Reagan (Tom Selleck) at his office. Reagan thanks Esiason for his work with the Women and Kids Fundraiser and asks if there is anything he can do for him in return.
When Danny is charged with using excessive force, Frank must decide whether to stand up for his son or for the reputation of his police force.
Billy Horne is a white man who was captured by the Shoshone when he was six. He comes into Ben & Joe's campsite one night uninvited.
A destitute rainmaker and his family arrive in drought-stricken Virginia City.  While Ben tries to help him make rain, Hoss tends to the man's seriously ill little girl.
Hoss helps Charlie and Will (Charlotte and Willomina), two young girls who just lost their father.  They go on a journey to find their only nearby relative, Aunt Cloe.
Hoss hires Waldo as a ranch hand after keeping Waldo from killing himself.  Hoss soon learns that Waldo is lousy at his job and only causes problems for everyone else due to his clumsiness.
In what is arguably the best comedy of the series, Hoss swears he has seen green elves running around the Ponderosa and a smooth-talking Irishman complicates matters even worse.
Hoss finds a kindred spirit in Skeeter Dexter, a lonesome young man who feels closer to animals than most people.
Hoss finds himself in another mess, this one involving a beautiful blonde, a moonshiner, and a nearsighted outlaw who is allergic to chocolate and flowers.

Kellie Conrad dances and her father plays the fiddle to earn a living.  Hoss feels a sense of guilt after he unintentionally hurts the arm that Kellie's father uses to play the fiddle, in a saloon fight with some roughnecks.
Feeling guilty for unintentionally ending the career of a professional boxer, Hoss vows never to fight again.  But things change when Joe is nearly beaten to death.
Wiley and Annie Kane arrive at the Ponderosa to work off their father's debt to Ben. It seems as though the elder Kane once swindled the Cartwright patriarch.
No one in Virginia City is happy to see ex-con Trace Cordell, especially the man he crippled in a gunfight, now married to Cordell's former girlfriend.
Ben helps Matthew Raine, a famous painter who has gone blind and now wallows in self-pity, discover a new purpose in life.  However, Raine's employee Gavin has other ideas.
In this series' highlight, little Michael Thorpe heads to the high country to ask God to spare his critically wounded father, believing he has found Him in the form of longtime fugitive Tom Cain.
The mother of a young outlaw condemned to hang, threatens to have her gang's hostages killed if her son is not set free.  One of the hostages is Joe.
Juan Ortega claims he has a land grant which gives him ownership of the entire Nevada Territory.
Ben is attracted to Sarah Reynolds, a member of a religious order led by her fanatical uncle.  When she is accused of being a witch, the Cartwrights step in.

Two robberies take place on stagecoaches that Adam is traveling on, and both times a knight in shining armor scares the robbers away.  Adam is accused of robbery, and his story about the knight is none too helpful.

programmes.d: The tournament nears its finale, as the matches of Sarada vs. Araya of the Hidden Sand and Mitsuki vs. Shinki of the Hidden San begin!
The final battle of the tournament begins with Boruto, Sarada and Shinki participating in a battle royale.
Momoshiki, Kinshiki and Urashiki of the Otsutsuki Clan suddenly appear in the arena filled with spectators, and Boruto witnesses the magnitude of his father's power in real combat.
Boruto realizes the magnitude of his father's love for the village and its people and, at the same time, his own weakness.
Sasuke and the Kage wage an intense battle against the ridiculously powerful Momoshiki and Kinshiki of the Otsutsuki Clan
With Boruto watching intently, Naruto and Sasuke begin their battle against a powered-up Momoshiki!
Boruto has made his rounds apologizing to everyone for his transgressions during the exam, but Momoshiki's prophecy continues to bother him.
Popular actors Tomaru and Ashina receive death threats from an unknown person, so Team 10 is assigned to a joint mission with Team 7 to guard them.
Tomaru's flirting has Cho-Cho on Cloud 9, but Sarada and the others worry that the lovestruck Cho-Cho has lost her focus on the mission!
The ninja in the gas mask appears again during filming and kidnaps Tomaru.
Metal's father, Rock Lee, announces that he will train Metal to master the ultimate taijutsu technique, the Eight Inner Gates.

programmes.st: The Hardest Rock in the World
programmes.d: The first Five Kage Summit since the attack by the Otsutsuki Clan is held in Hidden Leaf. The current Kage as well as their predecessors assemble, except the Third Tsuchikage, Ohnoki.
The ninja assigned to the Hidden Leaf Gate are attacked, and Mitsuki disappears.

programmes.st: The Other Side of the Moon
programmes.d: The village finds out that Boruto and Sarada have gone in search of Mitsuki, and Shikadai and his Team 10 are assigned a tracking mission to bring back them back.
Orochimaru tells Boruto and Sakura about the White Snake Sage who lives in Ryuchi Cave. On their way there, the two are confronted by Team 10.
Boruto and his friends are told they must pass a series of tests in order to meet the White Snake Sage!

When the class clown at the local high school is found murdered, the CSI team is called to investigate.
Grissom, Sara and Warrick are called in to investigate an abandoned, blood-splattered apartment and Nick and Catherine must examine a dead scuba diver lodged in a tree.
Grissom and his team investigate a murder suspect who is caught red-handed, burying the victims, while Catherine and Warrick take on the case of a woman found dead in a hotel spa.
Grissom and Nick investigate the death of a book restorer, while Catherine and Sara are called to the scene of a fatal train crash.
Grissom and Catherine investigate the apparent violent death of a woman found in a sandbox. Their investigation leads them to the underground world of s and m clubs.
Grissom and his team investigate a casino heist during which innocent victims were shot, while Catherine and Sara are called to the scene of a murder in a remote part of the desert.

Warrick is in charge for the first time as the team investigates the murder of the con artist, who has run off with some tourists' money only to get shot and killed in the parking lot. The prime suspect in the case turns out to be Captain Brass' daughter.
The CSI team is called in when a famous real estate entrepreneur is found dead in a hotel elevator.

Grissom and Sara are called to the crime scene when two murder victims are found hidden in pipes at a construction site in the middle of an alfalfa field, while Catherine and Nick investigate an ostensible hunting accident.
Grissom's nemesis, serial killer Paul Millander, reappears and claims a third victim in this gripping episode.
Catherine is ordered by a kidnapper to accompany a man who is to deliver $1 million in ransom to him or else he will kill the man's mistress.
Grissom investigates the murder of a Las Vegas photographer whose remains were dumped at a nearby body farm.
Grissom, Catherine and Sara are called in to investigate when a hockey player dies during a practice. Warrick and Nick look into the apparent drug-related death of a sax player at a casino.
Grissom investigates the murders of four monks who were shot point-blank while chanting in a Buddhist temple.
A bus carrying 23 passengers from Los Angeles to Las Vegas crashes less than 40 miles from its destination, killing nine people.

programmes.st: And How Does That Make You Kill?
programmes.d: When the daughter of Delko's therapist is murdered, Horatio and the CSI team must find the killer before Delko's darkest secrets are exposed.
A savage double murder in the Everglades pits Horatio and the CSI team against the brute force of Miami's own Russian mob.
When the CSIs investigate a murder in Miami's hippest fashion boutique, Horatio discovers that Julia's instability has turned her into a ticking bomb.
A 200-foot crane crashes into a Miami high rise, putting Calleigh and Delko in jeopardy and killing Horatio’s hope of catching a renowned crime boss.
A man is found handcuffed and stabbed in his hotel room, while a prank at the lab causes a rift in the CSI team and threatens their investigation.
When a murderer kidnaps an innocent baby, Horatio and the CSI team must find him before the child becomes his next victim.
When a savage killer runs rampant in Miami, Horatio must intervene to stop a member of the police force from getting too close to the case.
When a shooter targets the motel where Delko is staying, Horatio and the CSI team must look into Delko's past to find the killer.
The CSI team, with the help of local tipsters, fights to save a neighborhood on the brink of being taken over by a violent street gang.
Horatio and the CSIs use radical technology to unlock the secret of a man's mind when he shows up covered in blood with no memory of where he's been.
When a murder occurs during a horse race, Horatio and the CSI team discover that Ryan has a personal connection to the case.
Calleigh is in a coma after a smoke inhalation injury sustained while investigating a case involving a dead doctor, drug dealers, and black market organ transplants.
The CSIs make a shocking discovery about their murder victim, while Horatio tries to save his son from Julia's erratic behavior.
When a flight attendant is murdered en route, Horatio Caine and the CSI team uncover all the dirty secrets of airplane travel.
A home invasion becomes much more when Horatio Caine and the CSI team find out they're being targeted by the Russian mob.
When an innocent boy's life is in danger, Ryan is eventually forced to betray Horatio Caine and the rest of the CSI team.
A murder case involving extreme plastic surgery leads Horatio Caine to Ron Saris, who is alive and seeking revenge on Julia.
A billionaire is found dead in his bedroom, when Danny begins to process the scene he trips a panic button, sealing himself in with the victim.
The CSIs investigate the death of two models at New York City’s hottest fashion show-- where all of the clothes consist of nothing but body paint.
The CSIs investigate a prank gone bad when a “subway surfer” met with the ultimate wipeout, but soon understand that the death was no accident.
Stella thinks she has finally caught a night off, but the host of a private art show she’s attending is skewered with a high tech bow and arrow.
Stella and Mac examine a case in which a man was shot to death as a result of one of New York City’s dangerous water gun wars.
When a woman is found dead in her apartment building’s water tower, Mac and Lindsay must team up to find who her killer was.
When Mac and Stella discover a female corpse being devoured by beetles at a museum, they search for the villain behind the gruesome crime.
Mac, Danny, and Flack investigate the death of a medical intern and an illegal organ trafficking ring at New York hospital.
A patient from a mental hospital, who masquerades as Superman, is found dead in an alleyway The CSIs retrace his steps to restore justice to the city.
When an anonymous caller tells Mac there is a dead body buried at Giant’s Stadium, evidence found at the scene points to one of the CSIs.
The team investigates the murder of a limo driver at a Kid Rock concert. With Kid as a leading suspect, the CSIs find themselves backstage.
A young woman, dressed as a mermaid, is discovered floating in a bed of kelp.  The CSIs search Manhattan for her murderer.
A marine is found dead in Central Park. Across town, the team investigates the death of a woman found in a burned out car.

Steve McGarrett searches for both a maniacal rapist-murderer and the district attorney's daughter who is lost in the mountains of Oahu, fearful in the meantime that they will encounter one another.
Hit-and-run kills police officer, driver turns out to be head of Honolulu gambling syndicate. Only witness, debt-ridden gambler, extorts driver with knowledge of crime.
Barnard Hughes guest stars as a 71-year-old walking bomb who is threatening to blow himself up along with a group of hostages if his demands to stop the demolition of his home are not met.

After Mike gets a visit from an FBI agent and Sam comes to him with some secret plans, Bobby and Oliver believe that Sam is a spy.

Bobby needs money, so he starts selling hair tonic. Greg decides to buy a bottle right before graduation to help his little brother, but it turns his hair orange.

Claude comes up with a scheme, telling Vint that he could make nearly two thousand dollars by marrying a woman who needs her green card. Mama tells Vint if discovered, he could be in serious trouble and Vint decides not to do it.

The symphony's immense emotional scope, features innovative use of large-scale forces for breathtaking sound, and an ambitious philosophical journey that connects listeners to the grandeur of the natural world.

programmes.d: A highly-regarded California arson investigator is suspected of setting a series of fires, and in Texas, a man is convicted of raping and murdering his 68-year-old neighbor.

A murderer's saliva, found on envelopes, helps seal his doom 37 years after his first killing. And Colorado police crack a cold case 24 years later when they take a DNA sample from the victim's son that proves that his father murdered his mother.

A detective vows not to shave until he solves the murder of a young Oregon woman. It takes three years and a string of Mexican Mafia informants to crack the case and allow the dedicated detective to shave his beard.
A dry cleaning tag inside a sweatshirt left at a crime scene helps police track down a serial killer and rapist who had been eluding them for years.
In 1984, a 15-year-old girl is found murdered in her grandparents' home. For decades, a stalled investigation only fuels the town rumor mill, pointing an accusing finger at her 13-year-old sister.

We follow Det. Vince Velazquez of Atlanta and Capt. Russell Popham of East Point, Ga., as they work to solve the 1995 rape and murder of 14-year-old Nacole Smith, one of Atlanta's most notorious unsolved crimes.
One family faces two unsolved murders of their loved ones. It takes thirteen years for detectives to uncover the one missing clue that can lead them to the killer: the hidden crime scene.

In this special 100th edition of Cold Case Files, we look at the biggest serial murder case in U.S. history; hunt for the Green River Killer. Dave Reichert, the detective who made finding the killer his obsession, walks us through the case.
The body of Lori Nesson is found in a ditch in 1974, yet her death is not ruled a homicide. After four decades, the cause of death is changed to homicide, and the search begins for a killer.
Our cameras follow Detective Manny Reyes as he investigates the 1990 murder of a Fort Worth, Texas woman. Reyes talks to the woman's two sons, who believe that her husband, Bobby, was the murderer.

In late 1983, the bodies of five people abducted from a local fast food restaurant are found brutally murdered. The main suspect is long believed to be a well-connected local man, until new evidence reveals the true killers.
In the 1980s, a suspected serial killer preyed on women in small towns located on the banks of the Mississippi River until the murders abruptly ceased and went unsolved.
When 18-year-old Shannon Siders' body is found in the woods, everyone in the small town of Newaygo, Michigan, becomes a suspect--but no one is convicted of the crime.
The murder of an Ohio woman in 1974 is solved more than 20 years later after police get a crucial clue--the woman's husband was seen building a coffin-shaped box about the time the woman disappeared.
A Texas woman's murder is finally solved when the killer's plan to kill a second woman and stuff her into a duffel bag goes awry.

A Pointer mix is fixated on pine cones, while an Australian shepherd whines every time his owner switches on the vacuum cleaner.
Young fans Jessica and Rachel join Cesar as he deals with a tiny dog with an outsized personality and a nervous pit bull mix afraid of the sea.
Cesar helps owners of rescue dogs including a terrier mix that screams and a Belgian Tervuren scared of her own home; Cesar helps a family adopting their first dog.
Cesar travels to the U.K. to help troubled dog owners with a territorial street dog and a Dalmatian whose personality can turn ugly.
British problem dogs including wild German Shepherds, a dog that must be muzzled by court order, and an English cocker spaniel that hates cars.
Problem dogs in the U.K. including two dogs that spent most of their lives in Africa, and a barking Jack Russell terrier mix.
Cesar's English adventure ends with an aggressive Klee Kai, a collie mix that hates walks, and a hyper Labrador.
Cesar brings discipline to four chaotic Chinese crested dogs, an over-energetic mastiff mix and two unruly miniature dachshunds.
Cesar helps the lead singer of Rooney with his aggressive pit bull, while writer and producer Paul needs help with his two Boston terriers.
Mary had a Little Lamb, but now Little Lamb is lost.  Dora and Boots jump into a big book of Nursery Rhymes to bring Little Lamb back to her best friend, Mary.

Calling all trucks!  Boots sure loves trucks.  When Ice Cream Truck gets stuck in the muck at Play Park, Dora and Boots are off to the rescue.  Boots uses his truck phone to call his other truck friends for help along the way.
What are we going to do?  Cockledoodledoo!  Dora and Boots help their friend, Red Rooster, get to the Highest Hill so he can wake up the Sun.  Along the way we practice making lots of noise.
Dora and Boots meet Roberto, a very cool robot with a tool belt, flashing lights, stretching powers, and super strength. But Roberto's lost!

Benny the Bull finds a magic wand and turns himself into a potato by mistake. Oh no! It's up to Dora and Boots to bring their potato friend back to the Young Wizard so that he can change Benny back into a bull again.

Blast into outer space as Dora and Boots set off to bring stranded space creatures back home to the Purple Planet. Take a wild ride on a rocketship, travel through the Milky Way, and catch a ride on a comet.

Where do toys go when they're lost? To the Lost City! But the Lost City is really hard to find. Dora and Boots are on an educational, Indiana Jones-like adventure as they race through the Number Pyramid and the Jumbled Jungle.
Meet Diego, Dora's super cool cousin. Diego works at the Animal Rescue Center. He can make animal noises and talk to wild animals!

Woof!  Woof!  Dora and Boots have a new video game called "Save the Puppies."  A mean dogcatcher has locked up all the puppies in the Doggie Cages.  To save them, Dora and Boots super jump into the video game.

Dora and Boots read a fairy tale about a young kinkajou—a cute and cuddly forest creature—who is destined to be king. But the kinkajou loses his crown because he doesn't know the magic words, "por favor."

Dora, Boots and Diego need to bring a giant baby dinosaur home to his mommy at Dino Island.  It's a prehistoric adventure through a land of dinosaurs.  Tiptoe past a T-Rex, meet a Compsagnathus - the world's smallest dinosaur.
Today, Boots gets to do anything he wants, because it's his special day! Un día especial. Boots' favorite thing in the whole world is to visit his daddy at work.

Rescue Truck arrives at Diego's Animal Center to deliver a cute, little animal that's really lost: a penguin!  It's up to Dora, Boots and Diego to bring Ping³ino all the way back home to the South Pole.
Dora's cousin Daisy is playing in a big soccer game that's showing on TV. But Daisy's team is short a player. Daisy appeals to Dora to come play on her team and save the game. Run, Dora, run!
It's Halloween, and Dora and Boots are out trick-or-treating when a cute monster surprises them. Dora and Boots help hurry it home before the clock strikes 12.
What comes after "The End"? Dora and Boots are finishing a fairy tale and reach the end of the story. They wonder what happens next.

Oh no! Three of our friends are in trouble. Baby Jaguar is stuck in a tree, Isa is stuck in a big sand hole, and Benny is stuck in his balloon on top of the Gooey Geyser. Who do we have to rescue first?
It's bedtime, and Dora and Boots are having a sleepover. Dora has her teddy bear, Osito, but Boots can't find his cuddly dinosaur. Oh no! His dinosaur must have fallen out of his bag at Play Park.
Bawk! It's fiesta time! Dora and Boots are invited to the Big Red Chicken's Super Silly Fiesta! There will be silly snacks, silly games, silly hats, and even silly dancing. But, oh no!
Uh oh! Boots has a hole—un hoyo—in his boot! But Dora knows what to do. They can go to the Super Duper Fix-It Machine to fix it right up!
Boots loves baseball. He loves to run and catch and throw, but so far he's never gotten a hit. Boots is determined to get his first hit. Dora and Boots have a big baseball game today.

Happy Best Friends Day! Today's a special day for best friends to play together. Boots and Dora decide to meet for a picnic to celebrate. Boots is bringing chocolate; Dora is bringing yummy strawberries.
A is for armadillo, but where are the rest of the animals in the ABC book? They're missing! Dora and Boots jump into the giant alphabet book to help the little armadillo solve the mystery.

What do you want to be when you grow up? On today's adventure, Dora and Boots get to try all sorts of jobs—from a pilot to a chef to an archeologist. But what will Dora decide to be when she grows up?

Excited, Dora puts the Star Pocket on Backpack and Dora and Boots set off on their very first star catching adventure. Their educational journey will take them all the way to the Cloud Castle, as they try to rescue an adorable baby star.
Dora tells the story of how she first met Boots. On their very first adventure, Dora and Boots have to bring instruments back to the Fiesta Trio so they can play for the cranky Queen Bee.

Swiper swipes Dora's favorite necklace and flings it all the way to the top of Star Mountain! To get to the peak, Dora and Boots need to run up the Star Steps, climb up the Diamond, and make it through ice, wind and snow!
Swiper's invented a Super Swiping Machine and he's going to swipe Tico's birthday presents! Super Spies Dora and Boots to the rescue!
"Hola, hola!/ Hello, Hello!/ It's a great day for school/ You know!" Boots' music teacher, la maestra de música, needs to get to school in a hurry - but her bicycle is broken!
It's Dora's cousin Daisy's 15th birthday party, her quinceañera! But the party can't start without Dora and Boots - they need to teach everybody the mambo!
Dora's cousin Diego protects and defends all the animals in the rainforest. But in order to save a Baby Condor, Diego winds up trapped himself. And now he needs OUR help! ¡No te preocupes, Diego!
Oh no! Baby Jaguar's best friend, Baby Bear, is stuck on a ledge atop Bear Mountain - and the ledge is cracking! With Baby Jaguar leading the way, Dora, Boots and Diego race to the rescue!
Dora and Boots set out to help King Juan el Bobo find his crown so we can all go to his Mamí's birthday party. Where did the forgetful king put his crown?
Abuela gives Dora and Boots a present for Dora's new puppy, but they'll have to watch out for Swiper, who's got a bunch of new swiping tricks up his sleeves.

As Alexis and Amanda emerge from an exclusive bridal salon, a car suddenly screeches to a halt and Amanda is pulled inside. A high-speed chase ensues. As Dex forces the kidnapper's car onto the sidewalk, Amanda breaks free.

Dex tells a devastated Krystle that Daniel Reece is dead. Steven is outraged when Sammy Jo decides to fight for custody of her son in court. Jeff proposes marriage to Ashley. Sammy Jo learns that her monies will be held in trust with Krystle as executor.

Elena confesses to Amanda that nothing happened in the bedroom with Prince Michael. Sammy Jo fits her roommate Rita with a blonde wig and has her practice duplicating Krystle's voice. Fallon has chosen a new name and heads for Denver.

Those surviving the massacre in Moldavia are separated and held at the palace; Krystle and Alexis are imprisoned in the palace dungeon; Sammy Jo reveals her scheme to Rita; Fallon, suffering from amnesia, reacts to seeing the name Colby.

Blake secures the release of Krystle and Alexis, and the families return from Moldavia; Luke is buried; Rita's boyfriend Joel is anxious to help Sammy Jo further her scheme; Alexis is preoccupied with Galen's welfare; Fallon tells Miles she has amnesia.

Blake receives a business proposition from Jason Colby, whom he hasn't seen in 20 years; Jeff's Aunt Constance summons him to California; the State Department questions Blake; Rita undergoes plastic surgery to complete her 'Krystle Look.'

Krystle makes a surprise visit to Sammy Jo in New York; Adam follows Claudia to San Francisco; Constance awards nephew Jeff 50% of Colby Enterprises; Dominique is paid a visit by a mysterious man from her past.
Alexis learns Galen is alive in Moldavia; Jeff plans to move to California; Adam and Claudia are married; Krystle pays a surprise visit to Sammy Jo and spots her double, Rita.

Krystle is held at Delta Rho Farms while Rita impersonates her at the mansion; Dex is captured in Moldavia; The Colby family arrives in Denver to attend Blake's party; Jeff spots Fallon among the guests.
Dex orchestrates a dramatic rescue in Moldavia; Jeff discovers a clue to Fallon's whereabouts; Little Blake realizes Rita is not Krystle; Dominique places a mysterious overseas call.

After reaching safety, a paralyzed King Galen is hospitalized; Joel poses as a doctor to gain entry to the mansion; Claudia inherits an oil well; Rita drugs Blake; Galen makes Alexis a powerful promise from his hospital bed.

Sammy Jo panics at Blake's possible discovery of Krystle's captivity; Claudia plots with Adam to get her oil well back; Galen promises to make Alexis a powerful woman as he attempts to regain the throne.
Rita fears detection when Blake schedules an appointment for her with his doctor; Galen continues his scheming to regain the throne; Michael solely decides that he and Amanda will start a family.

Joel tells Rita that she must sleep with Blake; Joel and the real Krystle are seen together at a roadhouse; Galen sends Michael to New York for help; Adam offers Bart Fallmont a bribe to ensure the pipeline's success.

When Blake threatens divorce, Rita takes drastic action; Galen hides his recovery as he plots to regain the throne; Jonathan accepts a position with Bart Fallmont; Amanda receives a foreboding sign about Michael.

Blake receives the fatal dose of poison; Sammy Jo discovers a suspicious vial; Krystle attempts two deceptive escapes; a fist-fight breaks out over the pipeline; Dex battles for construction rights; Alexis receives a call from a stranger.

Cam's mother shares too much information while attending a charity event; Uncle Julius wants to be Cam's "talent scout."
Cam gets an unexpected wish from a dying teenager; Reggie wants Cam to pay for the family's expenses.
Complications arise when Missy works to get Reggie into an exclusive country club; a church pastor does not approve of Cam's sister or her lifestyle.
Cam and Reggie reunite with a childhood friend whose basketball dreams were derailed by a stint in prison; Cassie looks for houses; Cam is offered a shoe endorsement deal.

Cassie returns to the dating world and her determination to get what she wants sets her on a collision course with Cam; Reggie meets the peculiar and brilliant man who made Flaherty all his money.

The Greenleafs' IRS issues escalate when the FBI raids both Calvary and Triumph on suspicion of embezzlement; Grace questions her paternity when Aaron tells her that his father, Lionel, died.

After the success of her big day, Lady Mae is denied the right to run Calvary despite support from the Bishop; Grace takes over thanks to Connie and joins Harmony & Hope Ministries.

programmes.st: The Whole Truth and Nothing But
programmes.d: A driven newspaper editor must choose between a shocking front page headline or her own sister's reputation.
After a man, who has been living in his father's shadow, inherits the family taffy factory to which he has never felt attached, he must choose whether or not to sell it.
When a woman's husband is murdered and she is left penniless, she must face returning to the bad neighborhood she worked so hard to flee.
On New Year's Eve, a melancholy woman races against time to fulfill a promise she made to her father 45 years earlier.
When an honest man makes a desperate mistake, he must face dire consequences that put his entire family in danger.
The Angels must help a troubled young boy who wants to divorce his parents.
A rogue soldier turned outlaw is thrust into a relentless fight with a corrupt sheriff, his obedient deputies, and a dangerous drug cartel in order to protect his family.
A story set in Indochina in 1959, a land beyond rule and a time without mercy, and the birth of a legend.
A hit man must beat the top assassins in the world.
A hit man must beat the top assassins in the world.

An Egyptian police officer named General Yousef al-Masri lives in Karamouz neighborhood in Alexandria. The film dates back to the reign of King Farouk before the 1952 revolution in the English occupation of Egypt.

Quinn, a member of a SWAT unit, steps out of a park fountain in an Asian city with no recollection of who he is or where he came from. As he pieces together clues from his past, he vaguely recalls his young daughter, who has been kidnapped.

This breakneck thriller teams over half a dozen of the world’s biggest action stars for the martial arts event film of the year. When a hit is taken out on a billionaire’s daughter, it’s mercenaries versus assassins in an all-out war.
While released on furlough from prison, a lowly criminal evades his guards and returns to his old haunts to take revenge on the people that made him a cold-hearted killer.

Sasha wants a romantic dog, but Charlie argues that she'd be bored and that she should just accept Charlie for what he is! When a runaway bus nearly hits Sasha, Charlie takes the hit for her, and when he comes to, he's super-attentive.

Charlie suddenly finds himself leading the good life when Annabelle mysteriously assigns he and Itchy to help Carface and Killer at a meat packing plant. But is Annabelle really herself? And will Charlie see the light of goodness?

Charlie needs a vacation. Despite concerns, Charlie convinces Itchy to go with him. The road to leaving however, is not easy. So many terrible things happen that Charlie cannot walk a single city block without having to act as a Guardian Angel.
Stiles recommends The Wolf Pack to entertain at the Wolverton Festival. However, this bike gang brings big trouble, and Scott must find a way to scare them out of town.

programmes.st: The Curse of the Red Paw
programmes.d: Scott and his family make a trip to Rottenberg, Transylvania in order to reconnect with their past. However, danger lurks when the townspeople seem very spooked by the castle that the family inherited.

The Howards have been selected to be the All-American Family. However, with the press and media watching their every move, the family is concerned their secret will revealed. The family try to make a conscious effort to act as "normal" as possible.
A new family has moved to Wolverton, and they use their mysterious powers to turn the townspeople into zombies. The only people able to withstand their powers are the Howards.
Sabrina's band, the Flavor Babes, use a little magic to launch their careers. The much desired fame and riches end up tearing Sabrina, Chloe, Hilda and Zelda apart.
When Pi sees Sabrina's Uncle Zamboni flying through the air he is convinced there are paranormal rumblings in Greendale. He makes it his mission to prove it to the townspeople.
Sabrina is tired of the restrictions that come with being a kid. She casts a spell that catapults into adulthood.
Sabrina ends up in a new docu-series called, That Witch which becomes an overnight sensation! Sabrina soon tires of the demanding schedule and lack of privacy.
The return of Dr. Denman means trouble for the girls. Meanwhile, Emma is having family dramas of her own. With Zane’s unwitting help, Denman’s research at Mako Island uncovers the girls' secret!
Dr. Denman has discovered the girls' secret and trapped them on Mako Island. Their only chance to avoid being exposed is to use the lunar eclipse to give up their powers forever!
Under the influence of a Full Moon, the girls' powers are hugely enhanced and they wreak havoc on Lewis in his boat. The next day the girls realise they still need Lewis.
Emma uses her new powers to help Elliott win at soccer. Lewis decides to test the girls' increased powers. Cleo has had enough of Lewis' smothering and dumps him. Lewis meets Charlotte and they bond.

When Verne's techno-magic almost screws up a mission to the Centre of the Earth, Verne is humiliated and leaves the school. But Zarlak seizes the opportunity. Working through a magic artifact in Verne's backpack, he gives Verne evil powers.

UBOS and the kids return from an action packed chase in Rootopia, Center-earth, to find the school under a sleeping spell. They've saved a magical Rupunzel Plant from Zarlak and replant it in the school garden. However, there are bigger problems afoot.

On a white wintry day, Vonderland celebrates, “Festivus Solarus." Verne becomes smitten with a pretty young, visiting Spanish astrologer, who snubs him when she realizes he is a Mortie.  Verne feels like a misfit in both worlds, magic and Mortie.

programmes.st: Lucy Thinks Ricky has Been Drafted
programmes.d: Lucy opens a telegram addressed to Ricky from the War Department ordering him to appear at the Army's Fort Dix. This letter plus the drills Ricky and Fred have been practicing in the living room convince the women that their husbands have been drafted.

Lucy learns that Ricky needs a dancer for his Parisian nightclub act and is determined to get the part. Fred offers to teach her how to dance but Ethel arranges instead to have the nephew of the woman who runs the French laundry to give pointers.

Ethel wants Ricky to headline a benefit for her women's club. Lucy will only try to arrange it if she is on the bill as well. After hearing Lucy's terrible singing voice, Ethel is less than eager, but eventually agrees.

Lucy buys a costly dress, and when Ricky tells her to take it back or pay for it herself, she decides to get a job. She answers an ad for a babysitter and finds herself in charge of high-spirited twin boys who are to appear in an amateur contest.

Lucy's neighbor Miss Lewis has a crush on Mr. Ritter, the local grocer but istoo shy to invite him to dinner. Trying to play Cupid, Lucy invites him for her but he gets the idea that Lucy has fallen for him. Apparently Mr. Ritter is fond of Lucy as well.

In a deception planned to convince Ricky that she ought to be in his new nightclub act, Lucy pretends to have a nervous breakdown. She consults a book on abnormal psychology that reveals three complexes she assumes.
Lucy decides to break into show business by writing a play about a Cuban tobacco picker and entering it in her women's club play competition. Of course she wants Ricky to star in it but he refuses.
The Mertzes enjoy an evening singing around the piano with the Ricardos in their apartment. When they retire for the night and Lucy and Ricky continue singing, Ethel phones them demanding quiet.

Ricky needs a ballet dancer and a burlesque comic for his club's new musical revue. Lucy wants the ballet gig and takes dance lessons from a strict instructor. Learning the disciplined art is much more difficult than she imagined.

Peggy, a teenage neighbor, breaks up with her boyfriend Arthur because she is infatuated with Ricky. Lucy tries to help the clumsy schoolboy learn how to dance in order to win back Peggy's affections. To complicate matters more, Arthur falls for Lucy.

Lucy and Ethel are eager to get a closer look at the belongings of the O'Briens, new neighbors in the building. They snoop around in their apartment while they are away and when they hear the O'Briens return, Lucy is trapped in the closet.

After the Mertzes have a quarrel the Ricardos try their best to get them back together. Lucy invites each of them to dinner without the other knowing. The Mertzes finally reconcile but in the process, the Ricardos squabble.

Lucy hates the mustache that Ricky grows for a potential movie role and demands that he shave it off. When he refuses, Lucy gets a fake beard and glues it on her face. To teach Ricky a lesson, she kisses her husband with the beard on when he arrives home.

When Ricky forbids Lucy from gossiping, she tapes her mouth shut but reveals the latest rumor to Ethel through charades. However, it seems it's the proverbial black pot and kettle when Ricky shares with Fred a spicy tidbit about one of his band members.

Lucy and Ethel are tired of their dishpan hands and demand dishwashers from their husbands. They also don't think the Society Matrons League, a club they want to join, would approve. Their husbands believe they have it easy compared to the olden days.

A close inspection of her marriage license convinces Lucy that she and Ricky are not legally married. Because his name is misspelled on the certificate, Lucy insists Ricky go through the entire courtship and ultimately the marriage ceremony again.

Ricky discovers a wad of cash in Lucy's purse and closet full of strange valuables and assumes they're all her ill-gotten gains. He doesn't realize Lucy has been legitimately collecting for her club's fundraising bazaar.

Lucy feels left out when Ricky's two Cuban friends visit and converse mainly in Spanish. When she learns that little Renita, someone Ricky once danced with, is coming to town, she insists they reunite for a number.

Lucy and Ethel acquire a walk-in meat freezer. In an attempt to save money, they order two sides of beef, not realizing this is a tremendous amount. Hundreds of pounds of meat and $483 later, they must figure out a way to unload the beef.

Ricky is the emcee for a television variety show and Lucy wants to appear in one of its commercials. To prove to her husband that she has screen presence, she removes the inner parts of their TV set, gets into it, and does a commercial as he arrives home.

As a publicity stunt to further Ricky's career, Lucy pretends she's an exotic princess from "Franistan" who has traveled halfway around the world to see Ricky perform. She books a suite at the Waldorf-Astoria and gets a lot of press attention.

When Lucy screws up a dinner appointment with Ricky's new boss, Mr. Littlefield, and his wife because she is late, Ricky puts her on a strict time schedule. Later Ricky meets with Littlefield to discuss his possible promotion to manager of the club.

programmes.st: Lucy Gets Ricky On The Radio
programmes.d: Ricky impresses Lucy and the Mertzes with all the answers to a radio quiz show they are enjoying. He doesn't let on that the reason he knows the answers is that he was present at the taping. Lucy is so impressed that she signs him up as a contestant.

Ricky begins wearing a hat around the apartment because he thinks he's going bald. Lucy thinks he's worrying needlessly but goes to a store that specializes in hair restoration in order to help Ricky feel better.

Ricky tries to get a raise from his boss Mr. Littlefield but he is denied. Littlefield hires another act for the Tropicana and Lucy, Ethel and Fred decide to make sure no one shows up for the opening.

Upset at Lucy's irresponsible spending, Ricky suggests she could change her ways if she had a job. Lucy and Ethel propose switching roles with their husbands for a week; they will get jobs if the men stay home to do all the housework.
Ricky and his band are going on a tour and Lucy wants to go too. She dusts off her old saxophone and goes down to the club dressed in a zoot suit to audition for a spot.

The Ricardos' eleventh wedding anniversary is coming up and Ricky doesn't seem to be picking up the none-too-subtle hints Lucy is giving. She doesn't realize that Ricky has already made plans to buy a string of pearls at a discount from their neighbor.
After seeing Fred use a pair of trick handcuffs, Lucy uses a similar pair to attach herself to Ricky as gag. She wants him to stay at home and not go to a rehearsal for a live TV show the next day.
The artists must tattoo former smokers who have been scarred for life, and the six remaining artists on Team Nunez battle for a spot in the team's top five.
The artists are tasked with manipulating metal in the Flash Challenge, and the six remaining artists on Team Peck vie for a spot in the team's top five.
The artists must ink their canvases' heads in an intense two-day long Elimination Tattoo, and the battle between alliances heats up.

programmes.st: Like Sand Through the Hour Glass
programmes.d: Team Peck and Team Nunez face off to create custom designs for muscle cars, the artists ink hourglass tattoos on their canvases, and NFL player Von Miller is a guest judge.
One artist cracks under the pressure after an intense Flash Challenge, the artists must cover up lower back tattoos, and tattoo artist Robert Atkinson is a guest judge.
Dave takes a deep dive into the lives and strategies of the final six artists with never-before-seen footage from the season.
The artists carry their own weight in a team Flash Challenge, accuracy is tested in a head-to-head portrait Elimination Tattoo, and artist Tim Hendricks is a guest judge.
The artists must work with their teams to transform canvases into cyborgs, and tattooing legend and author Chris Garver is a guest judge.
The battle comes to a head as the final four artists must endure a grueling 15-hour tattoo marathon.
The final three artists tattoo live for America's vote, the eliminated artists return, and a 24-hour chest piece determines the winner of $100,000 and the title of Ink Master.
Artists from nine of America's best tattoo shops arrive to battle it out for $200,000, the title of Ink Master and the first-ever Master Shop title.
A massive twist shakes up the competition, a painstaking Flash Challenge puts shop relationships to the test, and a tough Elimination Tattoo tests the artists' fundamentals.
A veteran artist returns to take the competition by storm, a difficult Flash Challenge exposes the artists' weaknesses, and the artists tag-team an Elimination Tattoo.
The competition intensifies when the artists are tested on technical application, and two veteran artists make their returns.
Some shops lose their composure during a grueling color realism Elimination Tattoo, and a difficult canvas threatens one shop's spot in the competition.
The competition intensifies as another veteran artist returns, and artists must take on the ultimate test of artistry as they freehand their Elimination Tattoos.
One of the competition's most infamous veterans returns to shake up the game, and the pressure is on when the artists are tasked with a new-school Elimination Tattoo.

programmes.st: The Power of Banryu: Duel to the Death on Mt. Hakurei
programmes.d: Miroku and Sango see a mysterious lump of flesh in the depths of Mt. Hakurei.
Naraku has gained a new body and has been reborn.
Mt. Hakurei is destroyed. Koga falls to the bottom of it. Inuyasha saves him.
Inuyasha is pulled away from his friends when he is tricked by fake information that Kikyo is still alive.
Naraku's baby carries Kagome to an abandoned temple. He orders Kagura to place a corrupt Sacred Jewel shard in her.

programmes.st: Don't Boil It! The Terrifying Dried-Up Demon!
programmes.d: In feudal Japan, Naraku has sent a demon called Mimisenri to look for the Sacred Jewel shards.

programmes.st: Battle Against the Dried-Up Demons at the Cultural Festival!
programmes.d: On the day of the cultural festival, the dried demons that Kagome brought from feudal Japan are revived. They devour the food that Yuka and the others made.
A demon named Chokyukai is revived, and begins to steal girls. A young man named Kisuke comes to Kaede for help. Inuyasha go to defeat the demon.

programmes.st: Shippo's New Technique, The Heart Scar!
programmes.d: Five demon fox brothers believe Shippo to be a hero. They become his disciples to learn his special technique, the Wind Scar.

programmes.st: Trap of The Cursed Wall Hanging
programmes.d: Inuyasha and the gang meet Shinosuke, who is looking for his fiancée. They are led to a village of only women, and are separated by sex into their rooms.
At a village where only women live, a demon that was sealed away in a hanging scroll at Kanondo is revived.

programmes.st: The Woman Who Loved Sesshomaru, Part 1
programmes.d: Sara, a mysterious woman, appears before Sara. Sara was once saved by Sesshomaru. She was reincarnated just as she had died from an illness.

programmes.st: The Woman Who Loved Sesshomaru, Part 2
programmes.d: Sara asks Sesshomaru to destroy her along with the spirit. Sesshomaru complies, and uses the Tessaiga to destroy Sara along with the spirit.

programmes.st: The Last Banquet of Miroku's Master
programmes.d: Priest Mushin, the person who raised Miroku, is going to die. Miroku and the others are shocked.
A treasure stealing invisible demon appears. An old lady who failed to defeat him asks Inuyasha and the gang for help.
Akitoki, Hoji's ancestor is on a journey to offer the Hojo family heirloom, the Kenkon Naginata, a demon sword that brings disaster.

programmes.st: Mountain of Demons: Survival of the Duo
programmes.d: Akitoki and Inuyasha travel the shrine of the wind and thunder gods to make an offering to seal away the blade's demon powers.

programmes.st: The Great Duel at Shoun Falls!
programmes.d: Hoshiyomi uses the Kon blade to steal the Tessaiga's demon powers.

programmes.st: Eternal Love: The Naginata of Kenkon
programmes.d: Tsukiyomi, who is supposed to be dead, possesses Kagome and appears before Hoshiyomi.
Naraku's baby is bringing virtuous priests close to death and peering into their minds. He is trying to peer into the space between this world and the next.
Naraku's baby was split into two. One half comes back to life in the form of a child dressed in white.
Kanta is an otter demon child. His father's head was taken by Hakudoshi, and he is looking for his father's body.
The area between this world and the next, where Sacred Jewel shard is, is the demon graveyard where Inuyasha's father's corpse rests.

programmes.st: Bizarre Guards at the Border of the Afterlife
programmes.d: Inuyasha and the gang arrive in the land of fire. They discover a giant gateway within a cave in the mountains.

programmes.st: The Fiery Bird Master, Princess Abi
programmes.d: When the gateway in the Land of Fire opened, Kagome sensed the presence of the Sacred Jewel shard.

programmes.st: The Tragic Love Song of Destiny, Part 1
programmes.d: When Kikyo's younger sister, Kaede, was still a little girl, Kikyo entrusted her with a corrupt Sacred Jewel.

programmes.st: The Tragic Love Song of Destiny, Part 2
programmes.d: When Kikyo's younger sister, Kaede, was still a little girl, Kikyo entrusted her with a corrupt Sacred Jewel.
In order to defeat Naraku, Kagura looks for Sesshomaru. She appears before Rin and Jaken, but Sesshomaru is away.

programmes.st: The Mysterious Light that Guides the Saint
programmes.d: Kagome and the others sense Kikyo's presence from the purifying arrow. Meanwhile, Abihime attacks the village.

programmes.st: The Girl Who Overcame Time…and the Boy Who Was Just Overcome
programmes.d: In feudal Japan, the half demon Inuyasha was sealed away by the priestess Kikyo. Many years later he is revived by Kagome.
Kagome finds out that she may be the reincarnation of Kaede's late older sister, the priestess Kikyo, who sealed Inuyasha with her arrow.

programmes.st: Down the Rabbit Hole and Back Again
programmes.d: Kagome has the ability to see pieces of the Shikon Jewel. Inuyasha has the power to defeat demons. Both of their powers are needed to gather the shards of the jewel.
Kagome has returned to the present day and is relaxing in her home when Inuyasha comes looking for her. Some of Yura's demonic hair is on his body.

When Jane and Rogelio join forces to pitch a pilot, Jane is excited until she discovers a secret about her book being published. Alba and Jorge make an important decision about their future together. Rafael asks Jane to allow Luisa to meet Mateo.
When Rogelio tells Jane that the network wants her to write the script for their telenovela, at first she is excited, but begins to struggle balancing her time between that and her novel.

With Jorge officially moved into Alba's house with his stuff, it quickly has changed the dynamic, making Jane to uncomfortable. Rafael and Jane work on their co-parenting of Mateo now that they have a potential way to help Mateo.

After Rafael witnesses Mateo's behavior at school, he wants to take a different approach to his treatment. Rogelio is paranoid that River is plotting her revenge against him. Meanwhile, Jane convinces Petra to go on a single ladies' night out.

With Jane and Rafael finally in a good place, they are concerned to discover Mateo's treatment might be a problem. Alba and Rogelio are worried about Xo's recent behavior. Meanwhile, Petra is secretly pleased when Rafael and Jane begin fighting.

When Lina comes to town, Jane is excited to see her until Lina asks her for a favor. Rafael begins to work with Petra again but old tensions create new problems between them. Rogelio creates a plan to pressure the network to pick-up his pilot.

After Jane is struck with inspiration for her book, she immediately begins to write, but her next challenge is to get an agent. Rogelio has been so focused on being the star, he begins to contemplate taking on a different role instead.

When Jane's editor pitches her a dark twist for her book, Jane begins to wonder if the same thing might have actually happened to her. Rogelio helps River bond with her daughter, but River once again makes things difficult for him.

Jane is feeling great about all the book publishing prospects she has until an unexpected problem pops up. Petra and Rafael's working relationship has been going so well that Petra makes Rafael an unexpected offer.
Get ready for the finale with cast interviews from the cast of "Jane The Virgin".

With Jane and Rafael finally getting ready for their big day, Rafael's desire to help Jane's writing dream lands him in trouble. Xo and Rogelio must tell the family about their decision and not everyone takes it well.

All of Jane's meticulous life plans are turned upside down, however, when she sees her doctor for a routine check-up and is accidentally artificially inseminated with a specimen meant for someone else.
Jane Villanueva struggles to keep her unexpected pregnancy from taking over her life, but with her mom Xiomara pressuring her to sue the doctor who accidently inseminated her.

Jane considers making a life-changing decision about her and Michael's relationship. Alba  is disappointed in Xo's handling of Rogelio, so Alba takes it into her own hands to stop Rogelio from trying to see Jane.
In addition to being overwhelmed with all the wedding planning, Jane begins to feel guilty about her emerging feelings towards Rafael and decides to tell Michael during their pre-wedding counseling.
Furious at her mother Xo, Jane decides she needs some space and moves in with her fiancée, Michael. However, living together isn't what she thought it would be and Jane has to rethink her plans.
Jane and Rogelio begin to grow closer until she meets his mean twin teenage stepdaughters, who are determined to make her life miserable.
Michael is suing Brian for the cost to bail him out of jail but Brian said it was his girlfriend who called for help.
Paulita is suing her baby daddy for the value of a car, saying she left him because he's an abusive drunk.
Brian is suing Robert after he installed a faulty DVD player in Brian's car that hasn't worked right since day 1.

programmes.st: You Threw Me Out Of Your Taxi
programmes.d: Allison is suing the taxi driver she hired to drive her home after a medical procedure for kicking her out.
Terry is suing his ex-wife because he lent her money for their 18-year-old daughter to have surgery on her jaw.
Christina is suing someone she's known for 8 years over money she claims he owes her for a French bulldog.
Mirtha is suing her ex-husband for stealing her car and leaving her to pay the bills after he up and left.
Aisha claims Antwan harassed her and posted an explicit photo of her on social media without her permission.
Tyra is accusing her friend since highschool of allowing her car to be towed and junked due to a parking ticket dispute.

programmes.st: Family’s Not Cut Out to Work Together
programmes.d: Tylan is suing his great aunt, saying she hired him to paint her house but failed to pay.
David is suing John after he was unable to get the car registered because he claims the title wasn't notarized.
Vanessa is suing her former roommates for kicking her out and leaving her homeless.

programmes.st: You Sold Me A Fake Fish
programmes.d: Bruce says he thought he purchased a real taxidermy sail fish but says Michael fooled him into buying a plastic toy.
Anthony wants David to pay over $1300 in rent and belongings he claims David trashed.
Kevin wants his ex-fiancé to pay him back for a loan he gave her to pay off her credit card.
Olivia is suing her best friend's daughter over a utility bill but Kalia wants nothing to do with her.
Sherri is suing her ex-husband for her son's unpaid medical bill and emotional distress.

Charlie and Itchy are back! Those lovable mutts from the treasured Family hit "All Dogs Go To Heaven" return for an all-new Animated Musical Adventure. Features the voices of Charlie Sheen, Dom DeLuise and Sheena Easton.
The magical inhabitants of a rainforest fight to save their home, which is threatened by logging and a polluting force of destruction called Hexxus.
Three adventurous houseflies stow away on the Apollo 11 moon flight and are secret contributors to the mission's success. Animated fun voiced by Christopher Lloyd, Kelly Ripa, and more.
In futuristic Metro City, scientist Tenma (voiced by Nicolas Cage) creates an amazing robot boy with hidden talents unlike anything you've ever seen.
When a take-charge alpha wolf and a laidback omega wolf get relocated halfway across the country, the two must set off on an incredible journey home in this CGI-animated adventure.

In a world filled with Mad Scientists and Evil Inventions, one talented evil scientist's hunch-backed lab assistant has big dreams of becoming a Mad Scientist himself and winning the annual Evil Science Fair.

In love with Marina, the most beautiful penguin in all the land, hopeless romantic Hubie must thwart the plans of his evil rival, Drake, and win Marina’s heart in this charming, animated adventure from the creators of "All Dogs Go To Heaven."
An animated film about a barnyard rooster (the voice of Glen Campbell) who goes to Las Vegas and finds success as an Elvis-impersonating nightclub singer.

A wonderful, song-filled feature about an unlovable, murdered mutt (Burt Reynolds) who returns to Earth to do a good deed. He adopts an orphan girl who can communicate with animals and helps lead him to his killer.
